SELECT srrd.id, srrd.main_id, srr.source_id, srrd.source_detail_id, srr.source_code, srr.code, srrd.sku_id, srrd.sku_no, srrd.receive_qty, srrd.remark FROM so_return_receive_detail srrd INNER JOIN so_return_receive srr ON srrd.main_id = srr.id AND srrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE srr.is_deleted = FALSE
and srr.id in
#{id}
ORDER BY srrd.main_id
